newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Caliber EPS view may be cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Caliber EPS view may be cut.

text.p: --Merrill Lynch analyst Jeffrey Kauffman told Reuters Thursday he may lower his Q4 EPS estimate of $0.14 on Caliber System Inc after the company said it would post disappointing quarterly results at its Viking Freight Inc subsidiary.
--"I may need to cut my number by a dime," Kauffman said, noting that others will have to make steeper adjustments. The First Call Q4 consensus estimate is for $0.33 per share.
--Caliber also said it planned to eliminate 1,500 positions at Viking in 1997. "That should pay dividends eventually," Kauffman said.
